title: A crosstalk between auxin and brassinosteroid regulates leaf shape by modulating growth anisotropy.
authors: Xiong, Yuanyuan; Wu, Binbin; Du, Fei; Guo, Xiaolu; Tian, Caihuan; Hu, Jinrong; Lu, Shouqin; Long, Mian; Zhang, Lei; Wang, Ying; Jiao, Yuling
one_liner_zh: 该文研究植物激素调控叶片形状的细胞壁力学机制，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作、转录因子结合建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Leaf shape is highly variable within and among plant species, ranging from slender to oval shaped. This is largely determined by the proximodistal axis of growth. However, little is known about how proximal-distal growth is controlled to determine leaf shape. Here, we show that Arabidopsis leaf and sepal proximodistal growth is tuned by two phytohormones. Two class A AUXIN RESPONSE FACTORs (ARFs), ARF6 and ARF8, activate the transcription of DWARF4, which encodes a key brassinosteroid (BR) biosynthetic enzyme. At the cellular level, the phytohormones promote more directional cell expansion along the proximodistal axis, as well as final cell sizes. BRs promote the demethyl-esterification of cell wall pectins, leading to isotropic in-plane cell wall loosening. Notably, numerical simulation showed that isotropic cell wall loosening could lead to directional cell and organ growth along the proximodistal axis. Taken together, we show that auxin acts through biosynthesis of BRs to determine cell wall mechanics and directional cell growth to generate leaves of variable roundness.
abstract_zh: 叶片形状在植物种内和种间高度变异，范围从细长形到卵形。这主要由生长的近-远轴（proximodistal axis）决定。然而，关于近-远轴生长如何被调控以决定叶片形状，目前知之甚少。在此，我们表明拟南芥叶片和萼片的近-远轴生长由两种植物激素调控。两个A类生长素响应因子（AUXIN RESPONSE FACTORs, ARFs），ARF6和ARF8，激活DWARF4的转录，该基因编码一种关键的油菜素内酯（brassinosteroid, BR）生物合成酶。在细胞水平上，这些植物激素促进沿近-远轴更具方向性的细胞扩张，以及最终细胞大小。BRs促进细胞壁果胶的去甲基酯化，导致细胞壁在平面内的各向同性松弛。值得注意的是，数值模拟显示，各向同性的细胞壁松弛可导致沿近-远轴的方向性细胞和器官生长。综合来看，我们表明生长素通过BRs的生物合成来决定细胞壁力学和方向性细胞生长，从而产生不同圆度的叶片。
